description: This file defines the ConnectJobFactory class, which is responsible for creating various types of network connection jobs (ConnectJob) based on parameters such as endpoint, proxy, SSL configuration, and other connection settings. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and includes external dependencies related to network connection setup in Chromium.

classes.name: ConnectJobFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates various types of network connection jobs (ConnectJob) based on provided parameters such as endpoint, proxy, SSL configs, and connection options.

classes.name: ConnectJobFactory::SchemelessEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a connection endpoint without a known scheme, indicating whether SSL is used and containing a host/port pair.

methods.name: ConnectJobFactory::CreateConnectJob
methods.description: Creates a ConnectJob based on detailed parameters including endpoint, proxy, SSL configs, and connection options.

methods.name: ConnectJobFactory::CreateConnectJob
methods.description: Creates a ConnectJob based on whether SSL is used and a host/port endpoint.
